deck: Qrevo Pro keeps the all-rubber main brush. Roborock’s Pro page also says the same machine may be shown as Q Revo Pro.
warning: Qrevo S Pro is a separate model. The washable filter titled for original Qrevo only says it does not fit other Qrevo-series models. Curv and Edge appear on the Pro filter title, but not on the Pro main-brush title.
notes: On the robot or in the app, the name is Roborock Qrevo Pro. Roborock’s Pro page says that during a transitional period the same machine may be depicted as Roborock Q Revo Pro.
Qrevo S Pro has its own Roborock page. This fit check does not cover S Pro. The main-brush product title that includes the words Qrevo Pro does not include the words Qrevo S Pro.

Pro’s washable filter is the 2-piece whose title names Qrevo S, Qrevo MaxV, Qrevo Pro, Qrevo Plus, Qrevo Curv Series, Qrevo Edge Series, QV Series, and Qrevo S5V. A different Roborock filter is titled for original Qrevo only and says it is incompatible with other models in the Qrevo series.

The brush list is narrower than the filter list. Curv and Edge are on that washable-filter title, and Qrevo CurvX is on the 4-piece mop-cloth title, but the main-brush title that includes Pro does not name Qrevo Curv or Qrevo Edge. The Pro page lists an all-rubber main brush.

The 6-piece dock bag is titled for the Qrevo Series as a group. The same title also names S8 MaxV Ultra, S8 Max Ultra, Qrevo Curv Series, Qrevo Edge Series, Saros Series, and QV Series. A bag from that title does not by itself identify the Pro roller.

parts.fit: Use the 6-piece bag titled for the Qrevo Series as a group. That title also names S8 MaxV Ultra, S8 Max Ultra, Curv Series, Edge Series, Saros Series, and QV Series, so the bag name will not say Pro by itself.
Pro is named on the multi-model 2-piece with S, MaxV, Plus, Curv Series, Edge Series, QV Series, and S5V. Skip the filter Roborock titles for original Qrevo only.
The 4-piece mop-cloth title names Qrevo Pro together with S5V, original Qrevo, S, Master, MaxV, Plus, Slim, and CurvX.

The main-brush title names Qrevo Pro with Qrevo, MaxV, S, Plus, QV 35A, QV 35S, Q7 Max, S7 MaxV, S7 Pro Ultra, and S7 Max Ultra. It does not name Curv, Edge, or Qrevo S Pro. The Pro page calls this brush all-rubber.

deck: Qrevo MaxV is the Dock 2.0 machine with an all-rubber brush and lifting dual mops. It is not S8 MaxV Ultra, even when a dust-bag title prints both names.
warning: S8 MaxV Ultra sits on the same 6-piece dust-bag title as the Qrevo Series. The main-brush title names Qrevo MaxV and S7 MaxV, and it does not name S8 MaxV Ultra.
notes: Confirm the label says Qrevo MaxV, also written Q Revo MaxV. The MaxV product page describes Multifunctional Dock 2.0, an all-rubber main brush, and dual spinning mops that lift. That page is not the S8 MaxV Ultra.

The MaxV mix-up is bag versus brush. The 6-piece dust-bag title puts “Qrevo Series” in the same product name as S8 MaxV Ultra and S8 Max Ultra. The main-brush title names Qrevo MaxV and also S7 MaxV, Qrevo, Qrevo S, Qrevo Pro, Qrevo Plus, QV 35A, QV 35S, Q7 Max, S7 Pro Ultra, and S7 Max Ultra. S8 MaxV Ultra is not in that brush title.

Qrevo Curv and Qrevo Edge are also absent from the MaxV main-brush title. They do show up on the 2-piece washable filter that names Qrevo MaxV with S, Pro, Plus, Curv Series, Edge Series, QV Series, and S5V. Order the filter and the brush from those two different titles.

MaxV mop cloths are the 4-piece whose title also names S5V, original Qrevo, Pro, S, Master, Plus, Slim, and CurvX. Master and Slim are on that cloth title, then leave the brush title. Roborock sells their washable filter as a separate 2-piece for Qrevo Master, Qrevo Slim, and Saros Z70.
Do not substitute the filter titled for original Qrevo only. That product says it is incompatible with other models in the Qrevo series.
